revitalisation: Liechtenstein declared that no national minorities exist in its territory
It made a similar declaration on ratifying the languages Charter, so none is named either
The Advisory Committee does not endorse that as fact; it records nobody came forward

sources.label: Advisory Committee on the Framework Convention for the Protection of National Minorities, Fifth Opinion on Liechtenstein, adopted 1 February 2021 (ACFC/OP/V(2021)001), para. 13 and its footnote 6 — the state's declaration that no national minorities exist in its territory, the parallel declaration under the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, and the Advisory Committee's own qualifier that it is aware of nobody who has come forward
